text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Red 
Desire—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The brooch that was on my sacred satchel 
is gone...! Did I drop it somewhere?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I will take my leave here. I 
must retrace my steps to search for my 
lost belongings.
choice_data_list:
I'll help too. It should be easier to find 
if there are two of us.

I'll help too. It should be easier to find 
with the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! I'm much obliged. Well then, 
shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An imported brooch with a striking red gem 
that she had shown me before. I thought 
for sure we'd find it right away, but—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I've searched all the places we visited 
today, but... I can't find it.
choice_data_list:
Curfew's almost here, I need to head home 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. This too must surely be a new 
trial. I shall embark on another search 
expedition after school tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She continued searching for the brooch 
after that. I helped with the search 
during our outdoor training sessions, but—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I failed to come across it today as 
well.
choice_data_list:
...Wouldn't just buying the same thing 
work?
...Can't you just buy the same thing?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No... separated from the Saint, the brooch 
must be feeling anxious as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I definitely do not want to abandon them.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, to think that even with sacred 
power, it remains this hard to find—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am getting all fired up!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what darkness lies ahead on the 
path, I will never falter.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The path ahead will surely lead to "that 
place." For as long as you keep moving 
forward, you are bound to reach the light.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep searching until I find it... no 
matter how many days it takes, no matter 
where it leads me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I've checked the main streets and downtown 
areas, so—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The back alleys haven't been checked 
yet. I believe there was a gathering spot 
for some rather feisty folks back there.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe they were guided to a sacred 
place deep in the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ? Yes, is something the matter?
choice_data_list:
You'd better avoid going to dangerous 
places.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: No, there is no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am a Saint... therefore, there is no 
trial I cannot overcome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, I can't help but 
worry. There's a chance she could be in 
real danger—
choice_data_list: (I have to stop them early somehow...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was racking my brain for a 
solution—after that, an encounter that 
could only be described as destiny 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Flea Market Exhibitor
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! We're having a flea market! Feel 
free to take a look if you see anything 
you like!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's the exact same brooch as Red 
Desire's. Though surely it's not the one 
she dropped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I give her this instead, maybe she'll 
accept it and refrain from doing anything 
reckless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't what she lost. Still... it was 
surely better than recklessly searching in 
the dark without regard for danger.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...! I heard that the brooch was 
found!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Our bond has brought forth the gospel. 
Ah... what a saintly ending this is.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we've crossed paths once again. My 
dearest—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No... My heart is simply overwhelmed by 
this unexpected reunion.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking of me, searching for my 
brooch... and handing it to me like this. 
I am truly grateful."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "I shall never forget your good deeds."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "No, kind one. ...I am a blessed Saint."
choice_data_list: I see... I'm glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Protecting her smile, and keeping her out 
of harm's way— This is the least I can do 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let's attach it to our Holy Bag and go out 
again. This time, I'll be careful not to 
lose it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Well then, farewell. May holy blessings be 
upon you tonight as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But that is a burden for me alone to bear. 
I want her to be able to smile happily, 
without knowing a thing.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer?
choice_data_list:
We found the brooch, so let's head back to 
the academy

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes—this Saint's trial was over.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Well then, farewell. May holy blessings be 
upon you tonight as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...No. The unique, blessed numbers 
engraved upon the brooch differ from mine.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Reuniting with the brooch, her warm 
words—all of it was a lie.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Your feelings for me are genuine. ...Then 
the saint shall embrace your sins with 
love."
